func rotateRight(y *Node) *Node {
    x := y.Left
    t2 := x.Right

    x.Right = y
    y.Left = t2

    updateHeight(y)
    updateHeight(x)

    return x
}

{
    x := y.Left
    t2 := x.Right

    x.Right = y
    y.Left = t2

    updateHeight(y)
    updateHeight(x)

    return x
}

func rotateLeft(x *Node) *Node {
    y := x.Right
    t2 := y.Left

    y.Left = x
    x.Right = t2

    updateHeight(x)
    updateHeight(y)

    return y
}

{
    y := x.Right
    t2 := y.Left

    y.Left = x
    x.Right = t2

    updateHeight(x)
    updateHeight(y)

    return y
}
